name: @tundralibs/ui
description: HTML + CSS + JS component and layout library; first-class UI layer for rAPId. The npm package carries the compiled dist/ bundle (served by jsDelivr); the TypeScript templates are published to JSR.

scripts.build: npm run build:css && npm run build:js && npm run build:icons && npm run build:manifest
scripts.build:demos: tsx examples/pages/build-admin-theme.ts && tsx examples/pages/build-layouts.ts && tsx examples/pages/build-catalogue.ts
scripts.test: npm run build && npm run build:demos && npm run test:catalogue && npm run test:layouts && npm run test:all && npm run test:admin && npm run test:app
scripts.bun:build: bun scripts/build-css.ts && bun scripts/build-js.ts && bun scripts/build-icons.ts && bun scripts/build-manifest.ts
scripts.bun:build:demos: bun examples/pages/build-admin-theme.ts && bun examples/pages/build-layouts.ts && bun examples/pages/build-catalogue.ts
scripts.bun:test: bun run bun:build && bun run bun:build:demos && bun examples/tests/test-catalogue.ts && bun examples/tests/test-layouts.ts && bun examples/tests/test-all-pages.ts && bun examples/tests/test-admin.ts && bun examples/tests/test-app.ts
